title: Pale Fragment: Clarity Ascension
obscured_text: The white script is intact, but your sight skates over it as if the letters were polished silver.
It waits for a steadier self to read it.
revealed_text: Clarity Ascension is not triumph. It is the moment after cleansing when the world becomes sharp enough to hurt cleanly.
The fragment names Our Lady of Still Waters as listener, not judge. Yet it also warns that perfect defense can learn to strike the body it meant to save.
